title: Mobile phone with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Phone body -->
  <rect x='28' y='8' width='44' height='84' rx='8' ry='8' fill='#3A5A9E'/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x='33' y='18' width='34' height='58' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#1A2744'/>
  <!-- Screen inner glow -->
  <rect x='35' y='20' width='30' height='54' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#22335A'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='42' r='4' fill='#5CE1E6'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='42' r='4' fill='#5CE1E6'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#C8FBFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#C8FBFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M41 52 Q50 62 59 52' stroke='#5CE1E6' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#FF8FB1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#FF8FB1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='83' r='4' fill='#5A7BC4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='83' r='2' fill='#7A9BE0'/>
  <!-- Speaker -->
  <rect x='45' y='11' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5A7BC4'/>
  <!-- Camera -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#7A9BE0'/>
  <!-- Screen shine -->
  <rect x='36' y='21' width='6' height='20' rx='3' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.08'/>
</svg>
